package e2e

// 短测（ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF=1）：起服时的宣战补发扫描（ScanWars，方案 §2.5B“宣战”）随联盟数的代价。
//
// 3001 先起、建敌方联盟（此时只有它在 Found 队列组里；每个敌方至多 8 场战争，按总标记数备足），再起 3000 并让 3001 退出建盟（alliance.stop_founding），
// 之后建的联盟都在 3000 上。每一档 N（ALLIANCE_E2E_WARSCAN_COUNTS，缺省 1000,10000）：
//  1. 补建到 3000 上有 N 个联盟；
//  2. 停 3001，3000 上取 N 的千分之 ALLIANCE_E2E_WARSCAN_PENDING（缺省 10，即 1%，至少 1）个联盟向 3001 上的敌方宣战——
//     对方不可达，宣战方留下待确认标记（WarAcks）；
//  3. 停 3000（运行中的重试随进程丢失），拉起 3001，再拉起 3000：只有起服扫描能补发；
//  4. 量：拉起到 /readyz 的时间、预加载窗口、扫描本身（日志 "alliance: war scan done" 的 took）、拉起到全部敌方一侧
//     记上（Info 读敌方的 Wars）的时间、常驻内存峰值（每 100ms 采 ps）、Mongo 的 query / getmore 与扫描的键 / 文档数
//     （serverStatus 差值，整台私有 Mongo，含 3001 与后台轮询的底噪）、扫描期间 3000 的 Remote 写准入次数
//     （remote_entity.remote.prepare_total{batch="single"}；独占联盟稳定持有时不碰 Mongo，2026-11-06 之前每次取一次写许可，
//     即一次 Mongo findAndModify），以及列表查询本身的执行计划（explain：第一页与最后一页）。
// 每档结束时扫描必须已完成、补发必须全部完成，否则失败。

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"

	allianceentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/alliance"
)

type mongoStats struct {
	query, getmore, command, keys, docs int64
}

func (s *suite) mongoStats() mongoStats {
	var status struct {
		Opcounters struct {
			Query   int64 `bson:"query"`
			Getmore int64 `bson:"getmore"`
			Command int64 `bson:"command"`
		} `bson:"opcounters"`
		Metrics struct {
			QueryExecutor struct {
				Scanned        int64 `bson:"scanned"`
				ScannedObjects int64 `bson:"scannedObjects"`
			} `bson:"queryExecutor"`
		} `bson:"metrics"`
	}
	if err := s.mongo.Database("admin").RunCommand(s.ctx, bson.D{{Key: "serverStatus", Value: 1}}).Decode(&status); err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return mongoStats{query: status.Opcounters.Query, getmore: status.Opcounters.Getmore, command: status.Opcounters.Command,
		keys: status.Metrics.QueryExecutor.Scanned, docs: status.Metrics.QueryExecutor.ScannedObjects}
}

func (m mongoStats) minus(o mongoStats) mongoStats {
	return mongoStats{m.query - o.query, m.getmore - o.getmore, m.command - o.command, m.keys - o.keys, m.docs - o.docs}
}

// rssSampler 每 100ms 采一次进程常驻内存，stop 时返回峰值（MiB）。
func rssSampler(p *proc) (stop func() float64) {
	done := make(chan struct{})
	var peak float64
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer wg.Done()
		ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			if p.cmd != nil && p.cmd.Process != nil {
				if out, err := exec.Command("ps", "-o", "rss=", "-p", fmt.Sprint(p.cmd.Process.Pid)).Output(); err == nil {
					kb, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), 64)
					peak = max(peak, kb/1024)
				}
			}
			select {
			case <-done:
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
			}
		}
	}()
	return func() float64 { close(done); wg.Wait(); return peak }
}

// warScanLine 找日志里最后一次起服之后的 "alliance: war scan done"。
func warScanLine(path string, since time.Time) (map[string]any, time.Time, bool) {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false
	}
	defer f.Close()
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 1<<22)
	var found map[string]any
	var at time.Time
	for scanner.Scan() {
		var line map[string]any
		if json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &line) != nil || line["msg"] != "alliance: war scan done" {
			continue
		}
		stamp, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, fmt.Sprint(line["time"]))
		if stamp.After(since) {
			found, at = line, stamp
		}
	}
	return found, at, found != nil
}

func loadAverage() string {
	out, _ := exec.Command("sysctl", "-n", "vm.loadavg").Output()
	return strings.Trim(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), "{} ")
}

// explainOwnedPage 在 Remote 控制库（remote_entity.database，生成配置是 <工程名>_remote）上对 3000 的所有权列表查询（ListOwnedRemoteEntities 的同一过滤与排序）取执行计划。
func (s *suite) explainOwnedPage(owner int32, after int64) (plan string, keys, docs, returned int64) {
	tagSpan := int64(1) << entity.EntityIDTagBits
	remainders := bson.A{}
	for category := int64(0); category < 1<<entity.EntityCategoryBits; category++ {
		remainders = append(remainders, bson.M{"_id": bson.M{"$mod": bson.A{tagSpan, int64(allianceentity.EntityKindAlliance)<<entity.EntityKindShift | category}}})
	}
	filter := bson.M{"_owner_sid": owner, "_owner_shared": false, "_authority": true, "_id": bson.M{"$gt": after}, "$or": remainders}
	var out struct {
		QueryPlanner struct {
			WinningPlan bson.Raw `bson:"winningPlan"`
		} `bson:"queryPlanner"`
		ExecutionStats struct {
			Keys     int64 `bson:"totalKeysExamined"`
			Docs     int64 `bson:"totalDocsExamined"`
			Returned int64 `bson:"nReturned"`
		} `bson:"executionStats"`
	}
	cmd := bson.D{{Key: "explain", Value: bson.D{{Key: "find", Value: "_remote_entity_meta"}, {Key: "filter", Value: filter},
		{Key: "sort", Value: bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: 1}}}, {Key: "limit", Value: 1000}}}, {Key: "verbosity", Value: "executionStats"}}
	if err := s.mongo.Database(s.prefix+"_remote").RunCommand(s.ctx, cmd).Decode(&out); err != nil {
		s.t.Fatalf("explain: %v", err)
	}
	winning, err := bson.MarshalExtJSON(out.QueryPlanner.WinningPlan, false, false)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Sprintf("(plan of %d bytes: %v)", len(out.QueryPlanner.WinningPlan), err), out.ExecutionStats.Keys, out.ExecutionStats.Docs, out.ExecutionStats.Returned
	}
	return summarizePlan(string(winning)), out.ExecutionStats.Keys, out.ExecutionStats.Docs, out.ExecutionStats.Returned
}

// summarizePlan 把执行计划压成 “SORT>FETCH>IXSCAN{_owner_sid}” 这样的一行。
func summarizePlan(raw string) string {
	var node map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &node) != nil {
		return raw
	}
	if inner, ok := node["queryPlan"].(map[string]any); ok {
		node = inner // SBE 计划把经典计划放在 queryPlan 下
	}
	var parts []string
	for node != nil {
		part := fmt.Sprint(node["stage"])
		if key, ok := node["keyPattern"].(map[string]any); ok {
			names := make([]string, 0, len(key))
			for k := range key {
				names = append(names, k)
			}
			part += "{" + strings.Join(names, ",") + "}"
		}
		parts = append(parts, part)
		next, _ := node["inputStage"].(map[string]any)
		node = next
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, ">")
}

func TestAllianceE2EWarScanStartup(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	counts := []int{1000, 10000}
	if raw := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_WARSCAN_COUNTS"); raw != "" {
		counts = nil
		for _, field := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(field))
			if err != nil || n <= 0 {
				t.Fatalf("ALLIANCE_E2E_WARSCAN_COUNTS %q", raw)
			}
			counts = append(counts, n)
		}
	}
	perMille := 10
	if raw := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_WARSCAN_PENDING"); raw != "" {
		perMille, _ = strconv.Atoi(raw)
	}
	s := newSuite(t, 3*time.Hour)
	client := s.client(nil, 20*time.Second)
	b := s.start("alliance-3001", "alliance", 3001, procOptions{})
	// 一个联盟至多与 alliancerule.MaxWars（8）个联盟交战：敌方按每个 8 份备足，标记依次占满。
	total := 0
	for _, n := range counts {
		total += max(1, n*perMille/1000)
	}
	enemies, _ := s.foundMany(client, (total+7)/8, 4_000_000, 8)
	a := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{})
	s.admin(b, "alliance.stop_founding", nil)

	founded, leaderBase := 0, int64(5_000_000)
	var ids []int64
	declared := map[int64][]int64{} // enemy → declarers
	war := 0
	for _, n := range counts {
		fresh := founded // 本档新建的联盟从 ids[fresh] 起；标记只放在它们上（上一档的联盟已与敌方交战，再宣战会被拒）
		if more := n - founded; more > 0 {
			batch, took := s.foundMany(client, more, leaderBase+int64(founded), 24)
			ids = append(ids, batch...)
			t.Logf("PERF warscan founded %d more alliances on 3000 in %v (%.0f/s, load %s)", more, took.Round(time.Second), float64(more)/took.Seconds(), loadAverage())
			founded = n
		}
		// 新的待确认标记：从本档新建的联盟里均匀取（已有标记的联盟上一档已补完）。
		pending := max(1, n*perMille/1000)
		s.stop(b, syscall.SIGINT)
		step := max(1, (len(ids)-fresh)/pending)
		for j := 0; j < pending; j++ {
			index := fresh + (j*step)%(len(ids)-fresh)
			declarer, leader := ids[index], leaderBase+int64(index)+1
			enemy := enemies[war/8]
			war++
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(s.ctx, 20*time.Second)
			reply, err := client.DeclareWar(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("warscan-%d", war), leader, 1000, target(t, declarer), enemy)
			cancel()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("declare war %d on %d (enemy instance down): %v", declarer, enemy, err)
			}
			if !containsID(reply.Alliance.Wars, enemy) {
				t.Fatalf("declare war %d on %d: the declaring side was not recorded: %+v", declarer, enemy, reply.Alliance)
			}
			declared[enemy] = append(declared[enemy], declarer)
		}
		s.stop(a, syscall.SIGINT)
		s.launch(b)
		s.waitReady(b, 5*time.Minute)
		s.admin(b, "alliance.stop_founding", nil) // 拉起后重新加入了 Found 队列组：下一档的联盟仍要都在 3000 上

		loadBefore := loadAverage()
		before := s.mongoStats()
		launched := time.Now()
		stopRSS := rssSampler(a)
		s.launch(a)
		s.waitReady(a, 15*time.Minute)
		ready := time.Since(launched)
		atReady := s.mongoStats()
		grantsAtReady := s.metric(a, "remote_entity_remote_prepare_total", `batch="single"`)
		var scan map[string]any
		var scanAt time.Time
		s.eventually("war scan done", 15*time.Minute, func() (bool, string) {
			var ok bool
			scan, scanAt, ok = warScanLine(a.log, launched)
			return ok, "no scan line yet"
		})
		afterScan := s.mongoStats()
		grants := s.metric(a, "remote_entity_remote_prepare_total", `batch="single"`) - grantsAtReady
		s.eventually("every enemy records its wars", 15*time.Minute, func() (bool, string) {
			for enemy, declarers := range declared {
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(s.ctx, 5*time.Second)
				reply, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, enemy))
				cancel()
				if err != nil {
					return false, err.Error()
				}
				have := map[int64]bool{}
				for _, id := range reply.Alliance.Wars {
					have[id] = true
				}
				for _, declarer := range declarers {
					if !have[declarer] {
						return false, fmt.Sprintf("enemy %d lacks %d", enemy, declarer)
					}
				}
			}
			return true, ""
		})
		madeUp := time.Since(launched)
		peak := stopRSS()
		pStart, pDone, _, report := preloadWindow(t, a.log)
		took, _ := scan["took"].(float64)
		toReady, toScan := atReady.minus(before), afterScan.minus(atReady)
		plan, keys, docs, returned := s.explainOwnedPage(3000, 0)
		lastAfter := int64(0)
		if len(ids) > 1000 {
			lastAfter = entityIDOf(t, ids[len(ids)-1000])
		}
		planLast, keysLast, docsLast, returnedLast := s.explainOwnedPage(3000, lastAfter)
		t.Logf("PERF warscan n=%d pending=%d (load before %s, after %s): start→ready %v; preload listed=%d loaded=%d took %v; "+
			"scan alliances=%v waiting=%v took %v (done %v after launch); every enemy side recorded %v after launch; rss peak %.0f MiB (now %.0f)",
			n, pending, loadBefore, loadAverage(), ready.Round(time.Millisecond), report.Listed, report.Loaded, pDone.Sub(pStart).Round(time.Millisecond),
			scan["alliances"], scan["waiting"], time.Duration(took).Round(time.Millisecond), scanAt.Sub(launched).Round(time.Millisecond),
			madeUp.Round(time.Millisecond), peak, rssMB(a))
		t.Logf("PERF warscan n=%d Remote write admissions ready→scan done: %.0f", n, grants)
		t.Logf("PERF warscan n=%d mongo launch→ready query=%d getmore=%d command=%d keys=%d docs=%d; ready→scan done query=%d getmore=%d command=%d keys=%d docs=%d",
			n, toReady.query, toReady.getmore, toReady.command, toReady.keys, toReady.docs, toScan.query, toScan.getmore, toScan.command, toScan.keys, toScan.docs)
		t.Logf("PERF warscan n=%d owned-list page plan %s: first page keys=%d docs=%d returned=%d; last page keys=%d docs=%d returned=%d (%s)",
			n, plan, keys, docs, returned, keysLast, docsLast, returnedLast, planLast)
	}
}

func entityIDOf(t *testing.T, allianceID int64) int64 {
	id, err := entity.BuildEntityID(allianceID, allianceentity.EntityKindAlliance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return id
}

func containsID(ids []int64, id int64) bool {
	for _, have := range ids {
		if have == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
